name: Manual Mini Hand Pull Food Chopper | Spin Cutter Vegetable & Fruit Chopper | Food Processor for Onion, Garlic, Salad & Kitchen Use
description:
Make food preparation faster and easier with this Manual Hand Pull Food Chopper. Designed for quick and efficient chopping, this compact kitchen tool features sharp stainless steel blades and a smooth pull-cord mechanism that effortlessly chops vegetables, fruits, onions, garlic, herbs, nuts, and salad ingredients in seconds. Its lightweight, portable design requires no electricity, making it perfect for everyday cooking, camping, travel, and small kitchens. Easy to assemble, clean, and store, this manual spin cutter is an essential kitchen companion for convenient meal preparation.

Key Features
Manual hand pull food chopper for quick chopping
Sharp stainless steel blades for efficient cutting
Easy pull-cord mechanism for effortless operation
Ideal for vegetables, fruits, onions, garlic, herbs & nuts
Perfect for salad preparation and everyday cooking
No electricity required for convenient use
Compact and lightweight portable design
Durable food-grade construction
Easy to disassemble and clean
Suitable for home kitchens, camping & travel

Product Specifications
Product Type: Manual Hand Pull Food Chopper
Operation: Pull Cord Manual Mechanism
Blade Material: Stainless Steel
Body Material: Food-Grade Plastic
Power Source: Manual (No Electricity Required)
Suitable For: Vegetables, Fruits, Garlic, Onion, Herbs & Nuts

How to Use
Cut ingredients into small pieces before placing them inside
Close the lid securely
Pull the cord several times until the desired texture is achieved
Open the lid and remove the chopped ingredients
Wash all removable parts after use

Material / Composition
Food-Grade ABS Plastic
Stainless Steel Blades
Durable Pull Cord Mechanism

Safety Information
Handle the blades carefully during cleaning
Keep out of reach of children
Do not overfill the container
Clean thoroughly after every use
Store in a cool, dry place

Package Includes
1 × Manual Hand Pull Food Chopper
1 × Stainless Steel Blade Assembly
